n: Day of AI: AI Foundations for Middle Grades
t: A five lesson Day of AI unit using Quick Draw and Teachable Machine.
steps: Find the unit on the Day of AI site.
Register or log in to see all the resources.
Read the Day of AI privacy notice.
Prepare devices with a webcam for Teachable Machine.
Test Quick Draw and Teachable Machine on one student device.
Run the five lessons over several class periods.
